description: Canonical skills and agents that consumers keep byte-identical. sync-shared.sh copies them as regular files so a standalone checkout can use them without the source checkout. Claude Code supports symlinked skill directories when their targets exist. Entries are paths relative to this repository, such as plugins/core-lifecycle/skills/ci-status. Each consumer receives .claude/skills/<basename> or .claude/agents/<basename>.md. A bare name resolves against the legacy skills/ or agents/ layout. Run scripts/sync-shared.sh <repo> to refresh these copies and scripts/drift-check-shared.sh <repo> to check them. Omit assets that consumers adapt locally.
